parameters.query:
SELECT s.*
FROM user_schedules s
INNER JOIN "User_UC_Mappings" um ON um.user_id = s.user_id AND um.active = true
INNER JOIN feedback_config_rules f ON f.id = um.feedback_config_rule_id
WHERE f.usecase_id = $1;

UPDATE user_schedules SET interval_days = $2, measure_type = $3, trigger_percentage = $4, user_id = $5 WHERE schedule_id = $1
RETURNING schedule_id, interval_days, measure_type,trigger_percentage;

INSERT INTO user_schedules
  (user_id, interval_days, next_run_date, measure_type, trigger_percentage, active) 
VALUES 
  (
    {{ $('Parse Schedule Params').item.json.user_id }}, 
    {{ $('Parse Schedule Params').item.json.interval_days }}, 
    '{{ $('Parse Schedule Params').item.json.next_run_date }}', 
    '{{ $('Parse Schedule Params').item.json.measure_type }}', 
    {{ $('Parse Schedule Params').item.json.trigger_percentage }}, 
    TRUE
  )
RETURNING schedule_id, user_id;

UPDATE user_schedules s
SET active = false
FROM "User_UC_Mappings" um
INNER JOIN feedback_config_rules f ON f.id = um.feedback_config_rule_id
WHERE s.user_id = um.user_id
  AND um.active = true
  AND f.usecase_id = {{ $json.usecase_id }};
